title: Docker Hub account-conversion PAT reassignment

affected.type: Historical service-side exposure; vendor notification required

fixed.type: Vendor service remediation; no local version threshold

notes: No meaningful client or Docker version rule exists. Use administrator-supplied vendor notification and remediation evidence; do not infer exposure by probing Hub or testing tokens.
Vendor sent impacted-user/owner notifications on October 2 and says unnotified accounts were not exposed. This is a separate distinct exploit even though report discourages a standalone scanner.
scope_policy: One distinct exploit per repository; aliases and affected products share this scope.
